name: Kawasaki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kawasaki city emblem in violet: the kanji 川 (kawa, river) arranged as three nested, broken circular strokes.

features.role: Kawasaki city emblem — the kanji 川 bent into concentric circles
features.symbolism: stylises 川 ('river'), the first character of Kawasaki, whose name means 'river cape'
